explication: Forge is a cross-platform Magic: The Gathering rules engine and play application. Players choose a play mode, build or select a deck where applicable, then play against AI or other opponents; the README also highlights Adventure and Quest modes and Sealed, Draft, Commander, and Cube formats. The graph preserves the documented product branches and the central card, deck, rules, and AI layers. Internal wiring is limited to relationships visible in excerpts or the source index; unsampled mode wiring is not inferred.
